title: Reports root layout
responsibility: Applies report styles and renders the current page with the explorer chat where available.

inputs.name: +layout.children
inputs.description: The page content snippet passed in as the children prop, which the layout renders first with {@render children()} on every page it wraps. It is a required Svelte Snippet rendered with no arguments, so JSON cannot express it, and the layout does not check it or supply a fallback.

outputs.name: +layout
outputs.description: The markup this layout renders: the children content, followed by ConsoleChat only when page.url.pathname starts with /harness/branch/ or /harness/commit/. It is markup rather than a JSON value, and the five stylesheets imported by this module apply to the page it renders.
